events.summary: Black Ferns ran in 11 tries to stay unbeaten in the WXV Global Series, Mo'omo'oga Palu scoring inside two minutes and Braxton Sorensen-McGee kicking seven conversions; Evie Gallagher scored twice for Scotland.
With scores locked 19-19 after the hooter, Zoe Harrison intercepted a Black Ferns pass to score the winner, ending Whitney Hansen's unbeaten run; Ayesha Leti-I'iga and Mererangi Paul scored for NZ.

Seven tries (Lakai, Vaa'i, Roigard, Taylor, Carter, Moorby, Jordan) and 15 points from Damian McKenzie retained the Bledisloe Cup for a 24th straight year and stretched the Eden Park unbeaten run to 54.
Black Ferns scored 13 tries, including four to Shyrah Tuliau-Tua'a, to lead 43-0 at halftime and take a 1-0 series lead over a weakened France.
Six first-half tries had the All Blacks 36-7 up at the break, capped by Beauden Barrett's 70m intercept try; Josh Moorby and Barrett both scored twice for a 13th straight Bledisloe win.

events.note: Finals Weekend runs 27-29 Nov; day and opponent depend on final standings. If NZ top the southern table they play the Final, Sun 29 Nov 4:40pm GMT (5:40am NZDT Mon 30 Nov).

news.title: Frizell and Scott Barrett back in 34-man Bledisloe squad
news.summary: Codie Taylor captains a 34-man squad with Ardie Savea (shoulder) out; Shannon Frizell earns his first selection since the 2023 World Cup final and Scott Barrett returns from back surgery, while Noah Hotham misses out.

news.title: Mo'unga tears calf as Rennie calls it his hardest team to pick
news.summary: Richie Mo'unga was named at 10 then tore a calf at training and misses the Bledisloe series, with Damian McKenzie stepping in; Fehi Fineanganofo is also out and Ruben Love is done for the year.

news.title: All Blacks rout Wallabies 50-19 to retain Bledisloe Cup
news.summary: A five-try second-half surge at Eden Park kept the Bledisloe Cup in New Zealand for a 24th consecutive year.

news.title: Eight changes for Sydney as Jordie Barrett ruled out
news.summary: Leroy Carter's ankle injury promoted Josh Moorby to start, Fabian Holland joined Scott Barrett at lock, and Jordie Barrett was later withdrawn with a tight calf.

news.title: All Blacks beat Wallabies 43-21 in Sydney
news.summary: A 36-7 halftime lead set up a 13th straight Bledisloe win; Quinn Tupaea failed an HIA and Chay Fihaki was sin-binned for a head-on-head tackle late on.

news.title: Black Ferns stay unbeaten with 66-14 win over Scotland
news.summary: New Zealand led 38-14 at halftime in Edinburgh, though Scotland scored their first ever tries against the Black Ferns.

news.title: England edge Black Ferns 26-19 with last-gasp intercept
news.summary: Zoe Harrison's interception try after the hooter at Twickenham, in front of nearly 60,000, ended Whitney Hansen's unbeaten start as coach.

news.title: Hansen relishing home support for France series
news.summary: Whitney Hansen said selection for the first France Test was a long, tough meeting and starting spots are not locked in, as the side looks to bounce back from the England loss.

news.title: France bring four debutants to Hamilton
news.summary: France named four uncapped players and handed Alexandra Chambon the captaincy, with Manae Feleu and Pauline Bourdon Sansus unavailable.

news.title: Black Ferns score 13 tries in 81-12 rout of France
news.summary: Shyrah Tuliau-Tua'a scored four tries and Ayesha Leti-I'iga made four linebreaks as New Zealand went 1-0 up in the three-Test series; game two is in Whangārei next Saturday.
